import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def test_json_output_mode():
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "src/main.py", "--json"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        cwd=ROOT,
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0
    payload = json.loads(result.stdout)
    assert payload["greeting"] == "Welcome, traveler."


def test_default_text_mode_preserved():
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "src/main.py"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        cwd=ROOT,
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0
    assert result.stdout.strip() == "Welcome, traveler."
